strategy_name: Value Earnings Synergy — Risk Parity Variant

gate0_pit.detail: Lookahead detector CLEAN on run_all.R (257 lines) + s5_variants.R (288 lines). C1: RP covariance uses trailing 120-day Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage via .ledoit_wolf_shrink(ret_mat) — NOT full sample. lookback_dates bounded by all_dates[all_dates <= exec_date]. C2: DD brake uses dd_exp_lagged = c(1.0, head(dd_exposure, -1)) — t-1 lag confirmed. C4: Factor DB load_month_factors(sig_d) with Z_Score_Aligned. C5: MRS overlay reads daily_regime at signal date. C10: AvgTV20 uses shift(n=1L, type='lag'). C11: No direct FRED access. C13/C14/C15: Compliant.

gate1_performance.detail: SR 0.800 < 1.0 target. CAGR 11.7% < 16% target. MDD 37.91% > 25% target. All three primary metrics below Grade A thresholds. Worse than BASE (SR 0.857, CAGR 13.43%, MDD 34.31%) — RP weighting degraded all metrics.

gate2_robustness.detail: Rolling 3Y Sharpe positive 85.1% (good). Stress outperformance 2/3. OOS retention 0.441 (IS SR 1.048 vs OOS SR 0.462 — weak but above 0.40 minimum). Worst 6M return -19.64%. Max consecutive negative alpha months: 8.

gate3_role_honesty.detail: Self-labeled 'diversifier'. BM_Corr=0.628 (moderate, consistent with diversifier role). Not claiming core_alpha with sub-1.0 SR. Honest.

gate4_statistical.detail: FF5a annual alpha 5.70% with t-stat 1.41 (p=0.160). Not statistically significant at 5%. FF3 alpha t=1.15, Carhart4 t=1.17 — all insignificant. DSR not available. No Harvey (2016) t>3.0 significance.

gate5_ff5.detail: FF5 alpha t-stat 1.41 < 1.96. Alpha directionally positive (5.70% annual) but not robust. FMB Score lambda t=2.05 (significant), intercept t=2.94 — factor pricing power exists but total strategy alpha insufficient. Note: FF5 results from base strategy (overlays are same family, factor construction identical).

verdict.reason: RP weighting degraded STR_1333 base (SR 0.857→0.800, CAGR 13.43→11.7%, MDD 34.31→37.91%). Risk Parity did NOT help — Ledoit-Wolf cov estimation on 30 stocks with 120-day lookback is noisy in Korean market, leading to suboptimal allocation vs equal weight. Grade C: below all three primary targets.

comparison_vs_base.conclusion: RP variant is strictly dominated by EW base on all three metrics. Discard.

commentary.strength: PIT fully clean (C1-C15). Robust rolling 3Y positive rate 85.1%. Stress outperformance 2/3. Factor scoring (BM+ESBR synergy) concept remains valid.
commentary.weakness: RP weighting worse than EW on all metrics. MDD 37.91% is the worst among STR_1333 variants. OOS retention 0.441 weak. FF5 alpha not significant (t=1.41).
commentary.verdict_reason: Risk Parity on 30 Korean stocks with 120-day cov is unreliable — high estimation noise. Maillard et al. (2010) showed RP benefits require stable covariance structure; 30 Korean mid/small caps have regime-dependent correlation that defeats RP. EW dominates in this setting.
commentary.improvement: Not recommended. EW or IC-weighting is structurally superior for this factor set. If RP desired, needs larger universe (50+) with more stable covariance.
